checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: The final video lasts five seconds.
must.why: Frames sampled at 4.8 s of 5 s, so the clip is about 5 s.

must.item: Opening frame and subsequent footage match the first five seconds of the original clip.
must.why: The output is the original clip unchanged, a stream with a white paper boat. I can't compare it to the original directly.

must.item: The paper boat moves at the original speed, with no retiming or reordered footage.
must.why: Motion is smooth and continuous across frames, with no sign of retiming.

must.item: The ending is a simple cut, with no added fade or replacement shot.
must.why: The last frame at 4.8 s is full brightness and the same shot, with no fade.

must.item: The video remains 16:9, silent and free of text.
must.why: Frames are 16:9 and contain no text. I can't verify silence from stills, but the original was silent.

faults.what: The boat's shape shifts a little between frames, as is typical of AI footage. It is the original content, not a fault of the edit.

summary: The 5-second clip is the unchanged original with no fade, text or retiming. The request to shorten it was a no-op because the clip was already 5 seconds, and the assistant said so correctly.
